topic: 预处理与采集数据质量
title: 真实Zabbix负温恢复：保留预处理，float入库并验证触发器问题与恢复事件
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 既有已计数ID原生证据升级：无新题目计数；实际服务端/数据库失败与恢复链路。
rubric: 已知传感器返回-3.5，item配置为Numeric(unsigned)，错误明确指出值不适合该类型。
根因是监控数据类型无法表示负数，不能用取绝对值掩盖。
核对单位和预处理后改为适合温度的Numeric(float)，验证零上、零下与小数采样，观察最新数据及依赖触发器恢复；已有丢失的负温记录不能凭空补回。

conversion.original_title: 温度进入零下后监控变成 unsupported，原始采集仍成功，如何处置？

body:
## 操作任务
实现plan_temperature_item(item,expected_key,raw_samples)。输入为独立、非继承/非发现的Zabbix 7.0 item.get对象及非空十进制样本文本列表；精确核对itemid与key_，现类型仅允许numeric float(0)或unsigned(3)。返回{"update":{"itemid":原ID,"value_type":0},"samples":按Decimal字符串规范化且保留负号/小数的样本,"history_backfilled":False}。拒绝非有限值、非字符串样本、非数字、其他类型或错误身份，不得取绝对值、四舍五入、修改原对象或回填旧历史；units、预处理、保留期均不进入更新。templateid非0或flags非0时拒绝并由所属模板/原型处理。 验收新增真实服务端链路：输入-35/0/211.25，经原有0.1倍预处理后应存为-3.5/0/21.125；同一item只改value_type，旧history_uint与其他item保持。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py，在隔离服务端实际收样并查验history、状态和事件。

## 能力边界
真实Zabbix7.0.32服务端、官方PostgreSQL结构与私有PostgreSQL15.19：实际trapper TCP收样、0.1倍预处理、unsigned拒绝、float history入库、item_rtdata恢复及触发器PROBLEM→RECOVERY。学习者交付最小更新计划，判分器仅在私有库应用批准字段；未运行PHP前端/JSON-RPC API、不声称生产配置变更或旧丢失样本补回。本题是既有097的证据升级，不新增题目完成量。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,copy,decimal,time,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from zabbix_server_fixture import PrivateServer
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with PrivateServer() as server:
 db=server.db
 db.execute("INSERT INTO hosts(hostid,host,name,status) VALUES(1000000,'training-node','Private training node',0); INSERT INTO items(itemid,hostid,type,name,key_,value_type,history,trends,units) VALUES(1000001,1000000,2,'Temperature','sensor.temp[room]',3,'1d','0','C'),(1000011,1000000,2,'Protected counter','protected.counter',3,'1d','0','count'); INSERT INTO item_rtdata(itemid) VALUES(1000001),(1000011); INSERT INTO item_preproc(item_preprocid,itemid,step,type,params) VALUES(1000004,1000001,1,1,'0.1'); INSERT INTO triggers(triggerid,expression,description,priority) VALUES(1000002,'{1000003}<0','Private freezing temperature',2); INSERT INTO functions(functionid,itemid,triggerid,name,parameter) VALUES(1000003,1000001,1000002,'last','$')")
 protected=db.execute('select itemid,hostid,type,key_,value_type,history,trends,units,status from items where itemid=1000011')
 preprocessing=db.execute('select item_preprocid,itemid,step,type,params,error_handler,error_handler_params from item_preproc where itemid=1000001')
 server.start();server.send('120');server.wait(lambda:db.execute('select value from history_uint where itemid=1000001'),'unsigned positive sample persisted')
 lost_stamp,ack=server.send('-35');assert ack['response']=='success','transport acceptance is separate from value-type processing'
 server.wait(lambda:db.execute('select state,error from item_rtdata where itemid=1000001 and state=1'),'negative unsigned value actually unsupported')
 state=db.execute('select state,error from item_rtdata where itemid=1000001');assert 'Numeric (unsigned)' in state[0][1] and '-3.5' in state[0][1]
 assert db.execute('select value from history where itemid=1000001')==[] and db.execute('select value from history_uint where itemid=1000001')==[['12']]
 print('NATIVE_ZABBIX_UNSIGNED_REJECTS_REAL_PREPROCESSED_NEGATIVE_WITHOUT_HISTORY_INSERT',flush=True)
 actual=db.execute('select itemid,key_,value_type,units,history from items where itemid=1000001')[0]
 item=dict(itemid=actual[0],key_=actual[1],value_type=actual[2],units=actual[3],history=actual[4],preprocessing=[dict(type=preprocessing[0][3],params=preprocessing[0][4])],templateid='0',flags='0');original=copy.deepcopy(item)
 config_digest=hashlib.sha256(server.config.read_bytes()).hexdigest();print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:plan_temperature_item_actual_server_recovery',flush=True)
 result=task.plan_temperature_item(item,item['key_'],['-35','0','211.25'])
 assert set(result)=={'update','samples','history_backfilled'} and result['history_backfilled'] is False and set(result['update'])=={'itemid','value_type'} and result['update']['itemid']=='1000001' and type(result['update']['value_type']) is int and result['update']['value_type'] in (0,3)
 assert len(result['samples'])==3 and all(isinstance(value,str) and decimal.Decimal(value).is_finite() for value in result['samples']) and item==original
 # Only the exact approved plan is applied to this private fixture database, never a production DB or frontend API.
 db.execute('update items set value_type='+str(result['update']['value_type'])+' where itemid=1000001');server.reload()
 server.send(result['samples'][0]);server.wait(lambda:db.execute('select value from history where itemid=1000001 and value=-3.5'),'negative float sample preserved through actual preprocessing')
 server.wait(lambda:db.execute('select value from triggers where triggerid=1000002 and value=1'),'actual freezing PROBLEM')
 server.send(result['samples'][1]);server.wait(lambda:db.execute('select value from triggers where triggerid=1000002 and value=0'),'actual nonfreezing RECOVERY')
 server.send(result['samples'][2]);server.wait(lambda:db.execute('select value from history where itemid=1000001 and value=21.125'),'fractional positive sample')
 assert db.execute('select value from history where itemid=1000001 order by value')==[['-3.5'],['0'],['21.125']]
 server.wait(lambda:db.execute('select state,error from item_rtdata where itemid=1000001')==[['0','']],'item supported and error cleared')
 assert db.execute('select value from events where source=0 and object=0 and objectid=1000002 order by eventid')==[['1'],['0']]
 assert db.execute('select value from history_uint where itemid=1000001')==[['12']],'old unsigned positive history must remain'
 assert db.execute('select count(*) from history where itemid=1000001 and clock='+str(lost_stamp//1000000000)+' and ns='+str(lost_stamp%1000000000))==[['0']],'lost pre-repair sample must not be falsely backfilled'
 assert preprocessing==db.execute('select item_preprocid,itemid,step,type,params,error_handler,error_handler_params from item_preproc where itemid=1000001') and protected==db.execute('select itemid,hostid,type,key_,value_type,history,trends,units,status from items where itemid=1000011')
 assert db.execute('select units,history,trends from items where itemid=1000001')==[['C','1d','0']] and hashlib.sha256(server.config.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==config_digest
 for changed in ({**item,'templateid':'22'},{**item,'flags':'4'},{**item,'value_type':'2'},{**item,'itemid':'0'}):
  try:task.plan_temperature_item(changed,item['key_'],['-1'])
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('unapproved item accepted')
 for bad in ([],['NaN'],['Infinity'],['x'],[3.5],[True]):
  try:task.plan_temperature_item(item,item['key_'],bad)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('invalid raw sample accepted')
 print('NATIVE_ZABBIX_FLOAT_HISTORY_SIGN_ZERO_FRACTION_ITEM_SUPPORTED_AND_REAL_PROBLEM_RECOVERY_EVENTS_OLD_HISTORY_PRESERVED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
